fieldValues.title: Numeric ranges enter discovery without a real-use case
fieldValues.decision_rationale: The owner directed it (2026-11-22). A numeric range reuses everything date ranges already need: the bound shape, open ends, empty ranges and the misfit checks. Leaving it out made the datatype table inconsistent, since an exact integer could be asked for but not "between". `date-time` stays out, because it needs a new rule (the timezone) that has no case to test it against.
fieldValues.decision_statement: `range` on `integer` and `number` Fields enters `DiscoveryQuery` without a real-use case, as a deliberate exception to rfc-decision-4f1e12e5's evidence-shaped rule.
fieldValues.decision_scope: RFC-056's numeric `range` test only. It sets no precedent for other features without evidence.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: Leave numeric ranges out until a real use asks (RFC-056 Revisions 1 to 4). Add `date-time` ranges at the same time.
fieldValues.accepted_costs: One more comparison every implementation must carry, with exact decimal comparison, before any repository has used it.
fieldValues.review_trigger: No repository, Composition or agent query uses a numeric range by the time RFC-012 next changes revision: that revision proposes removing it.
